title: Successive run equals one further step
statement: Let $M$ be an oracle machine with $k$ ordinary work tapes, let $O$ be a language over its symbol alphabet, let $c$ be a configuration with $k+1$ work tapes, and let $t\in\mathbb{N}$. Running $M$ relative to $O$ for $t+1$ steps from $c$ gives the same configuration as taking one step relative to $O$ from the configuration reached after $t$ steps.
hypotheses_covered: An oracle machine $M$ with $k$ ordinary work tapes
An oracle language $O$ over the symbol alphabet
